threat_event: Ransomware encrypts store, payment, supply chain, and e-commerce systems across regions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Retail is a frequent target; about 10,500 endpoints and POS devices across 112 stores; AB flat networks (see R-003)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-10; all tier-1 processes (P05)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of PCs and servers; PAM; immutable backups; active-active payment switch; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: AB conversion and interim segmentation (POAM-001); OT segmentation (POAM-005); annual ransomware exercise including the disclosure committee (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Malicious script on payment pages (e-commerce skimming) captures card data that customers type at checkout
threat_source: Organized e-skimming group using a compromised third-party script supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 47 scripts on payment pages; express checkout and cart pages outside the script inventory and tamper detection; the tag manager can still inject scripts there
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 web checkout; about 3.4 million online card payments a year
regulatory_driver: N44-45-R01 (PCI DSS 6.4.3; 11.6.1); state breach laws; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Script inventory, integrity values, and weekly tamper detection on the main web checkout; WAF; content security policy in report-only mode on express checkout
treatment_plan: Extend inventory, integrity values, and tamper detection to express checkout and cart pages; remove the tag manager from payment pages; targeted penetration test (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Payment page scripts without written justification; tamper alerts closed within 24 hours

threat_event: Attacker on an AB store network captures clear-text card data between legacy PIN pads and store servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No encryption at the PIN pad; flat store networks; legacy directory; no SIEM feed; shared local administrator account (R-018)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-14 (14 AB stores; about $1.64 million of sales a day)
existing_controls: EMV chip acceptance; legacy processor fraud monitoring; anti-malware on store servers
treatment_plan: Conversion wave 1 (5 Alabama stores) by 2026-12-15 and wave 2 (9 Tennessee stores) by 2027-03-31 (POAM-001); interim SIEM collectors and daily review (POAM-009)
key_risk_indicator: AB stores converted; AB store servers reporting to the SIEM

threat_event: Memory-scraping malware on core-store lanes or store controllers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large POS estate; vendor remote support sessions
existing_controls: Encryption at the PIN pad, so lanes and controllers never hold clear-text card data; application allow-listing; file integrity monitoring; EDR on controllers
treatment_plan: Accept residual risk: encryption at the PIN pad removes clear-text card data from lanes; reviewed annually
key_risk_indicator: Allow-list violations; FIM alerts on controllers

threat_event: Primary processor outage lasts beyond the 4-hour store-and-forward window
threat_source: Processor infrastructure failure or a cyberattack on the processor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One processor carries about 98% of card volume; no written or tested plan beyond store-and-forward
existing_controls: Processor contract RTO 2 hours; store-and-forward; two colocation sites; cash logistics with two providers
treatment_plan: Write and test the extended outage procedure (POAM-016); evaluate a secondary processor for card-present volume

threat_event: A third-party service provider with PCI DSS responsibilities is breached or falls out of compliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 71 TPSPs; 9 with expired or missing AOCs; 14 with no written split of responsibilities
existing_controls: Tiered vendor program; annual AOC collection; contract terms for tier-1 vendors
treatment_plan: Collect AOCs, complete responsibility matrices, and add AOC delivery terms at renewal (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: TPSPs with a current AOC; TPSPs with a responsibility matrix

threat_event: Refrigeration or building controls are tampered with through a vendor remote tool or the shared store VLAN, and spoilage goes undetected
threat_source: Cybercriminals or a compromised refrigeration vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor tools outside PAM; OT controllers on the back-office VLAN at 37 stores; all alarm notifications through one vendor cloud
existing_controls: Local controller alarms; manual temperature checks during outages; on-call technicians
treatment_plan: Move vendor access to PAM (POAM-004); segment OT (POAM-005); exercise the manual fallback
key_risk_indicator: Stores with OT segmented; vendor sessions through PAM

threat_event: Bulk theft of loyalty and CDP data for 3.1 million members through stolen cloud credentials or misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large data store; many analytics users; partner data exports
regulatory_driver: N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); Tennessee Act 47-18-3204(a)(3); state breach laws
existing_controls: Pseudonymous IDs for analysts; database activity monitoring for bulk exports; landing zone guardrails
treatment_plan: Approval workflow for exports above 50,000 records; quarterly CDP access recertification
key_risk_indicator: Bulk export alerts; CDP privileged users

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over customer accounts to redeem rewards and order with saved cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1.4 million online accounts; password reuse; MFA optional for customers
existing_controls: Bot detection; breached-password checks; one-time code for adding or changing saved cards
treatment_plan: Risk-based MFA for sign-ins from new devices and for reward redemptions over a threshold

threat_event: A material card data incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality process fails under pressure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The disclosure committee has never exercised a card compromise; card brand, acquirer, and forensic investigation steps are not linked to the materiality timeline
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter; materiality worksheet; outside securities counsel on retainer
treatment_plan: Update the playbook; full tabletop with the disclosure committee on 2026-11-12 (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: Tabletop completed; time from severity-1 declaration to first committee meeting

threat_event: Pricing engine produces higher prices or weaker offers for lower-income neighborhoods or delivery zones
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fairness tested only by store cluster, not by neighborhood income or delivery zone
existing_controls: Price bounds; cost floor; daily exception report
treatment_plan: Neighborhood and zone fairness tests; minimum weekly offer value for all active members (POAM-021)
key_risk_indicator: Price index spread by zone; offer value ratio by income group

threat_event: Dynamic prices rise during a declared state of emergency (price gouging)
threat_source: Model behavior during demand spikes before and after hurricanes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Demand-based engine; emergencies are declared most years in Florida and the Gulf states; freeze configured for Florida only
existing_controls: Emergency price freeze configured for Florida stores in 2026-09
treatment_plan: Freeze for all five states tied to declarations; test before each hurricane season

threat_event: AI use cases operate without governance review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 12 use cases not reviewed by the AI governance committee
existing_controls: AI governance committee; procurement intake block for new AI features
treatment_plan: Complete the 5 reviews by 2026-11-30 (POAM-021)
key_risk_indicator: Use cases reviewed; AI features found outside the inventory

threat_event: Tennessee Act noncompliance: no data protection assessments for targeted advertising and profiling, and no consent record for precise geolocation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Act effective 2025-07-01; AB members (mostly in Tennessee) joined the loyalty program in 2026-03
existing_controls: Privacy notice; consumer request portal answering within 45 days
treatment_plan: Complete data protection assessments; consent capture and record for precise location (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: Assessments completed; consent records for Tennessee app users

threat_event: Clean room outputs allow re-identification of members or reveal small audiences to CPG clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Minimum audience thresholds not enforced in 2 of 6 report templates
existing_controls: Aggregated outputs; client contracts prohibit re-identification
treatment_plan: Enforce thresholds in all templates; output review for new templates (POAM-020)

threat_event: Delivery provider A outage stops 62% of home deliveries
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration; the shift to providers B and C has never been tested at volume
existing_controls: Providers B and C under contract
treatment_plan: Surge terms with providers B and C and a volume test (POAM-022)
key_risk_indicator: Share of deliveries with provider A

threat_event: SNAP EBT transactions fail during a payment switch failover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EBT routing never tested in failover; manual voucher drills at 3 of 112 stores
existing_controls: Active-active switch; manual vouchers under state retailer agreements
treatment_plan: EBT failover test; manual voucher drills at all stores (POAM-011; POAM-024)
key_risk_indicator: EBT routing failover tested; stores drilled

threat_event: The shared local administrator account on AB store servers is abused to install malware or move between stores
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared account across 14 store servers; password unchanged since 2023
existing_controls: Store servers behind the legacy firewall
treatment_plan: Unique local administrator passwords with automated rotation; retired at conversion (POAM-008)

threat_event: AB staff keep OCPP order management access after termination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminations keyed manually from the legacy HR system
existing_controls: Weekly reconciliation by the service desk
treatment_plan: Daily reconciliation now; federation of AB identities by 2026-12-31 (POAM-007)

threat_event: Zero-day in an internet-facing edge device (VPN or firewall) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices at headquarters, colocation, and the AB legacy VPN
existing_controls: Emergency patch target 72 hours; threat intelligence
treatment_plan: Retire the AB legacy VPN at conversion; replace remaining remote access VPN with the zero-trust service
key_risk_indicator: Exposed edge devices; days to patch known exploited vulnerabilities

threat_event: Phishing leads to theft of a privileged credential
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: More than 5,000 email users
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for all privileged users; mail filtering; monthly phishing simulations
treatment_plan: Accept residual risk: FIDO2 keys for privileged access make a stolen password insufficient
key_risk_indicator: Phishing click rate; privileged accounts without FIDO2 (target 0)

threat_event: Store employees commit refund or gift card fraud with manager override IDs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Override IDs shared informally at some stores; 1,140 inactive POS operator IDs
regulatory_driver: Other: SOX internal control over financial reporting
existing_controls: Refund and override exception reporting by asset protection
treatment_plan: POS operator ID cleanup and inactivity disable (POAM-015)

threat_event: Business email compromise causes a fraudulent supplier payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 4,000 suppliers; bank detail change requests arrive by email
regulatory_driver: Other: SOX internal control over financial reporting
existing_controls: Call-back verification for bank changes; payment approval limits
treatment_plan: Bank changes only through the supplier portal with MFA
key_risk_indicator: Bank change requests outside the portal

threat_event: PIN pad tampering or overlay skimmers at lanes or self-checkouts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,780 PIN pads; 41 not reconciled to a lane; inspection logs incomplete
existing_controls: Tamper-evident seals; periodic inspections; cashier training
treatment_plan: Reconcile the inventory; digital inspection logs with photos (POAM-014)

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a POS or payment switch software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor updates reach about 2,650 lanes and the switch
existing_controls: Staged rollout; lab store testing; signature checks on packages
treatment_plan: Require software bills of materials and signed packages from POS and switch vendors; 72-hour pilot-store soak

threat_event: SOX IT general control deficiency in ERP access or change management
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complex ERP roles
regulatory_driver: Other: SOX internal control over financial reporting
existing_controls: Annual SOX testing; quarterly access reviews
treatment_plan: Accept: the SOX program tests these controls every year

threat_event: Payment switch configuration error causes chain-wide declines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complex routing tables; emergency changes without post-implementation approval
existing_controls: Change advisory board; staged configuration; rollback scripts
treatment_plan: Enforce post-implementation approval within 2 business days (POAM-012)

threat_event: Unpatched high-risk vulnerabilities on store controllers are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 high-risk vulnerabilities past the 30-day target; local firewall disabled on 3 of 25 sampled controllers
existing_controls: Quarterly internal scans; payment VLAN segmentation
treatment_plan: Patch through the vendor-certified update path; configuration check after every support session (POAM-013)

threat_event: A rogue device connected at a store without NAC reaches store networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NAC at 61 of 98 core stores
existing_controls: Port security on payment VLANs; quarterly wireless scans
treatment_plan: NAC at all core stores (POAM-005)

threat_event: Card numbers typed by customers into chat, email, or contact center notes are kept in clear text
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contact center tools and the customer service mailbox
existing_controls: Data loss prevention masks card numbers in email and chat
treatment_plan: Accept: masking verified quarterly; agents trained
key_risk_indicator: Unmasked card numbers found in quarterly scans

threat_event: Ransomware or failure of the warehouse management system stops a distribution center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: On-premises system at each DC
existing_controls: Separate instances at each DC; backups
treatment_plan: Annual DC recovery test with the other DC taking priority loads

threat_event: The ERP price file is corrupted or late, causing wrong prices at registers and online
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly batch; manual overrides
existing_controls: Price file validation; last good file on store controllers
treatment_plan: Accept: validation and rollback are in place

threat_event: A hurricane or flood closes stores, a DC, or a colocation site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida and Gulf coast exposure
existing_controls: Hurricane plan; two colocation sites in different states; generators at stores
treatment_plan: Annual hurricane exercise that includes IT recovery

threat_event: Inactive POS operator IDs are used to process fraudulent refunds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,140 operator IDs inactive more than 90 days
existing_controls: Lead reset required after lockout
treatment_plan: Disable inactive IDs automatically (POAM-015)

threat_event: Service account secrets for switch interfaces are stolen and reused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Secrets rotated by hand
existing_controls: Secrets vaulted in PAM
treatment_plan: Automated rotation

threat_event: Express checkout went live without a penetration test, leaving an exploitable flaw
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Released after the annual test
existing_controls: Static and dynamic tests in the pipeline
treatment_plan: Targeted penetration test before QSA fieldwork (POAM-002)

threat_event: Retail media tags collect customer data beyond what the privacy notice describes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tags on cart pages; privacy notice last updated 2024
existing_controls: Tag review at vendor onboarding
treatment_plan: Update the privacy notice; tag governance board (POAM-023)
key_risk_indicator: Tags without an approved data use description

threat_event: Visa transaction information reaches retail media clients beyond the purposes card brand rules allow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: A clean room ingest job carried a processor token field until 2026-07 (removed)
regulatory_driver: Visa Core Rules 1.9.4.2 (contractual, through the acquirer)
existing_controls: Weekly data discovery scan on Cloud B
treatment_plan: Data contract for clean room ingest that excludes all payment fields (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Payment fields found in Cloud B scans (target 0)

threat_event: Self-checkout computer vision wrongly flags customers as not scanning items, leading to confrontations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-005 not yet reviewed
existing_controls: Staff guidance: assist, never accuse; alerts go to attendants only
treatment_plan: Committee review; false alert rate monitored by store (POAM-021)

threat_event: Facial recognition is introduced through a vendor feature in CCTV or self-checkout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor products include optional face matching
regulatory_driver: N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); Tennessee Act (biometric data is sensitive data)
existing_controls: Board prohibition (2024)
treatment_plan: Prohibit by contract; disable features; quarterly configuration checks

threat_event: AI resume screening produces adverse impact on applicants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ranking feature in the applicant tracking system
existing_controls: Ranking disabled
treatment_plan: Ranking stays off until the committee review and an adverse impact analysis are complete

threat_event: Refrigeration anomaly model suppresses or deprioritizes a real alarm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-010 is High tier and not yet reviewed
existing_controls: Model only reorders alarms; all alarms still notify
treatment_plan: Committee review; alarm suppression disabled until validated (POAM-021)

threat_event: Customer service virtual assistant gives wrong refund or allergen information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative assistant answers customers
existing_controls: Allergen and medical questions routed to agents; answer guardrails
treatment_plan: Accept: guardrails and a monthly sample review
key_risk_indicator: Incorrect answers in the monthly sample

threat_event: Personal information of children is collected despite the age 18 requirement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Self-reported age at sign-up
regulatory_driver: N44-45-R07 (16 CFR Part 312, only with actual knowledge)
existing_controls: Age gate; deletion when discovered
treatment_plan: Accept: the services are not directed to children

threat_event: A contact center agent misuses customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 agents with lookup access
existing_controls: Masked fields; access logging and review
treatment_plan: Accept: masking and monitoring in place

threat_event: Supplier portal account takeover exposes sales data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,400 suppliers; inactive supplier accounts
existing_controls: MFA; quarterly supplier administrator attestation
treatment_plan: Automatic disable of supplier accounts inactive 90 days (P09 CC6.2)

threat_event: Mobile app precise location data is kept longer than needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Location events stored with order history
existing_controls: Location requested only at check-in
treatment_plan: Delete location after pickup; consent record (POAM-019)

threat_event: DDoS attack on the storefront during the holiday peak
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public storefront and APIs
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection and WAF; peak load tests
treatment_plan: Accept: provider protection tested before peak

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration exposes an e-commerce storage bucket
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many accounts across two clouds
existing_controls: Guardrails block public storage; daily posture scans
treatment_plan: Accept: preventive guardrails in place

threat_event: Audit logs are altered or deleted to hide attacker activity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Attackers target logs after gaining privilege
existing_controls: Write-once log archive in a separate account
treatment_plan: Integrity alerting on log source gaps and archive policy changes

threat_event: The key injection facility or PIN pad supplier is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Third-party key injection for all PIN pads
existing_controls: Supplier AOC and PIN security attestation
treatment_plan: Track the facility in the TPSP AOC program (POAM-003)

threat_event: Card data on the AB legacy processor link is intercepted because the link still allows outdated TLS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy link accepts TLS 1.0 as a fallback
existing_controls: Link runs inside a site-to-site VPN
treatment_plan: Disable outdated protocols now; retire the link at conversion (POAM-017)

threat_event: The QSA cannot validate requirements that need a targeted risk analysis because the analyses are missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Targeted risk analyses missing for 3 of 11 requirements that need one
existing_controls: Targeted risk analysis template and register
treatment_plan: Complete the 3 analyses before QSA fieldwork (POAM-018)

threat_event: The 2026 ROC finds noncompliance, leading to acquirer action and remediation costs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AB stores enter ROC scope for the first time; open POA&M items
existing_controls: Annual ROC since 2015; pre-assessment by Internal Audit (P07)
treatment_plan: Agree the AB scope approach and milestones with the acquirer and the QSA before fieldwork

threat_event: Electronic shelf labels display wrong prices after compromise or error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ESL base stations with default credentials (R-062)
existing_controls: Register prices come from the POS, not the labels; scanner accuracy audits
treatment_plan: Change credentials and segment base stations (POAM-006)

threat_event: The data warehouse keeps customer data longer than needed, increasing breach impact
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No automated retention on analytics tables
existing_controls: Retention schedule exists on paper
treatment_plan: Automated retention rules on analytics tables

threat_event: Loss of the two senior payment switch administrators leaves no one able to change routing safely
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key-person dependency
existing_controls: Vendor support contract
treatment_plan: Cross-train two engineers; runbooks for routing changes

threat_event: Bots enumerate gift card balances or abuse promotions online
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public balance check page
existing_controls: Bot detection; rate limits
treatment_plan: Accept: rate limits and monitoring in place

threat_event: Lost or stolen handhelds expose cached customer order data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3,200 handhelds in stores
existing_controls: Mobile device management with remote wipe; no card data on handhelds
treatment_plan: Accept: remote wipe and short cache lifetime

threat_event: Cyber insurance does not cover the full cost of a card compromise (card brand assessments, forensics, notifications)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Policy sublimits for payment card costs
existing_controls: Cyber policy with payment card sublimit
treatment_plan: Raise the payment card sublimit at the 2027 renewal; model losses with P05 and P08 values

threat_event: An acquisition closes without security due diligence and integration funding
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The 2025 AB deal had no security workstream until after closing
existing_controls: Integration Management Office
treatment_plan: Security due diligence and integration budget required in deal approvals

threat_event: Default vendor credentials on ESL base stations allow access to the store operations network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default credentials on base stations at 3 of 12 sampled ESL stores (P07 finding); base stations share the back-office VLAN
existing_controls: Store firewall separates the payment VLAN
treatment_plan: Change credentials at all 40 stores; add base stations to configuration checks (POAM-006)

threat_event: POS manipulation enables SNAP benefit trafficking, putting store authorizations at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manager overrides and inactive operator IDs (R-022, R-034)
existing_controls: EBT transaction analytics by asset protection
treatment_plan: Add EBT patterns to exception reporting; link to POAM-015

threat_event: The primary processor loses its PCI DSS validated status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single processor for 98% of volume
existing_controls: Annual AOC check; contract right to terminate
treatment_plan: Quarterly check of the processor listing and AOC
